name: M3_PMS100MI_GetMatLine
description: Retrieve detailed information for one specific material line (component) on a manufacturing order. This operation uses the facility, product number, manufacturing order number, and material sequence number to return a single record.

inputParameters.name: FACI
inputParameters.description: Facility where the manufacturing order is registered.

inputParameters.name: PRNO
inputParameters.description: Product number for the manufactured item.

inputParameters.name: MSEQ
inputParameters.description: Sequence number of the retrieved material line.

outputParameters.name: CONO
outputParameters.description: Company number.

outputParameters.name: FACI
outputParameters.description: Facility where the manufacturing order is registered.

outputParameters.name: PRNO
outputParameters.description: Product number for the manufactured item.

outputParameters.name: MFNO
outputParameters.description: Manufacturing order number.

outputParameters.name: RESP
outputParameters.description: User responsible for the manufacturing order.

outputParameters.name: MTNO
outputParameters.description: Component number used on this material line.

outputParameters.name: ITDS
outputParameters.description: Description of the component on this material line.

outputParameters.name: WOSQ
outputParameters.description: Reporting number identifying this material line within the order.

outputParameters.name: BAQT
outputParameters.description: Yield quantity reported for the manufacturing order.

outputParameters.name: MSEQ
outputParameters.description: Sequence number of the retrieved material line.

outputParameters.name: WMST
outputParameters.description: Material status on the manufacturing order indicating allocation, picking, and issue progress.

outputParameters.name: OPNO
outputParameters.description: Operation number where this component is first used in the routing.

outputParameters.name: ACTS
outputParameters.description: Operation element number linking the component to a specific operation element.

outputParameters.name: ITTY
outputParameters.description: Item type classifying the component, for example raw material or semi-finished item.

outputParameters.name: DWPO
outputParameters.description: Drawing position for this component on the product drawing.

outputParameters.name: ACTI
outputParameters.description: Indicates whether this component is an active item or a catch weight item and how catch weight is inspected.

outputParameters.name: CNQT
outputParameters.description: Required quantity of the component on this material line.

outputParameters.name: PEUN
outputParameters.description: Engineering unit of measure used to express the component quantity.

outputParameters.name: FXCD
outputParameters.description: Indicates whether the component quantity is fixed regardless of the manufacturing order quantity.

outputParameters.name: WAPC
outputParameters.description: Normal waste percentage applied to this component in planning and reservations.

outputParameters.name: BYPR
outputParameters.description: By/co-product code indicating whether the component is a normal item, by-product, co-product, or main product.

outputParameters.name: CRTM
outputParameters.description: Indicates whether the component is treated as critical material in availability and planning checks.

outputParameters.name: SPMT
outputParameters.description: Issue method defining when and how this component is issued to the manufacturing order.

outputParameters.name: WHLO
outputParameters.description: Warehouse from which the component will be issued.

outputParameters.name: WHSL
outputParameters.description: Location within the warehouse from which the component will be issued.

outputParameters.name: LGTH
outputParameters.description: Length factor used with width and other factors to calculate the component quantity.

outputParameters.name: WDTH
outputParameters.description: Width factor used with length and other factors to calculate the component quantity.

outputParameters.name: LWF1
outputParameters.description: Additional factor 1 used in the material consumption calculation for this component.

outputParameters.name: LWF2
outputParameters.description: Additional factor 2 used in the material consumption calculation for this component.

outputParameters.name: RDAT
outputParameters.description: Planned reservation date when the component is to be issued.

outputParameters.name: TIHM
outputParameters.description: Time when the latest transaction for this material line was performed, in hours and minutes.

outputParameters.name: RPQA
outputParameters.description: Accumulated issued or reported quantity for this component in the alternate unit of measure.

outputParameters.name: REQA
outputParameters.description: Reserved quantity for this component in the alternate unit of measure.

outputParameters.name: SCQA
outputParameters.description: Accumulated scrapped quantity for this component in the alternate unit of measure.

outputParameters.name: RPDT
outputParameters.description: Date when the latest reporting transaction for this material line was performed.

outputParameters.name: ALQA
outputParameters.description: Allocated quantity for this component in the alternate unit of measure.

outputParameters.name: PLQA
outputParameters.description: Quantity of this component printed on the picking list but not yet delivered, in the alternate unit of measure.

outputParameters.name: BANO
outputParameters.description: Lot number identifying the specific lot of the component used on this line.

outputParameters.name: CMCD
outputParameters.description: Inheritance control setting defining whether lot and/or attributes from this component are inherited by the manufactured item.

outputParameters.name: FMT1
outputParameters.description: Optional free-text description of the material on this line, used especially when no item master exists.

outputParameters.name: FMT2
outputParameters.description: Optional technical reference text associated with the material line.

outputParameters.name: WODP
outputParameters.description: Indicates whether order documents have been printed for the manufacturing order.

outputParameters.name: MDBF
outputParameters.description: Lead time offset in workdays indicating when this component must be available before the order finish date.

outputParameters.name: ATNR
outputParameters.description: Attribute number identifying any configured attribute connected to this material line.

outputParameters.name: BFCW
outputParameters.description: Indicates whether backflush issue quantities for this component are based on catch weight.

outputParameters.name: ADBF
outputParameters.description: Indicates whether detailed backflush transactions are created for this component when aggregated backflush is used.

outputParameters.name: ISTO
outputParameters.description: Indicates whether this component is handled as intermediate stock during manufacturing order reporting.

outputParameters.name: ALON
outputParameters.description: Indicates whether the component's location is treated as an allocatable location when issuing via picking list.
